_note: Map the company's column names to the kit's names. Leave a value empty when the export has no such column. Dates are parsed in most common formats; amounts may carry currency symbols and commas.

schedule._format_help: snapshot = one row per customer per month (needs snapshot_date). contract = one row per customer with start_date and optional end_date; the kit expands it to months.

rules._types_help: line_type values are matched case blind after trimming. A line whose type is unknown is treated as recurring if the amount is positive and the service period is set, otherwise it is flagged for review. A negative amount with no type is treated as a credit.
rules._periodless_help: A recurring invoice line with no service period (QuickBooks Online exports have none) gets one only when its amount is an exact whole multiple of the schedule MRR for that customer, 2 to 36 months, starting in the invoice month; it is marked period_source = inferred_from_schedule. Set to "invoice_month" to keep every periodless line in the month it was raised.
